gate.rule: if R2 fails to triangulate on >5% of structures, report the rate and do NOT score it

pipeline_correctness.reduces_to_R1_when_fed_ground_truth: verified in CP31's O0 gate at 200/210

mandatory_co_reported_operating_point.note: MUST appear wherever R2 is mentioned. R2 is a lower bound from ONE concrete extractor, never a ceiling for extraction in general.

mechanism_finding.explanation: structures over-triangulate (n_recovered > n_true) DESPITE the detector finding fewer atoms than exist: a dropped disc in one view lets a ray from a different atom pass the cross-view consistency test, manufacturing phantom sites. Extraction errors propagate NON-MONOTONICALLY through triangulation, so recall alone does not predict reconstruction quality.

what_remains_unmeasured: the fraction of the R1-to-R4 gap attributable to extraction. R1 assumes perfect extraction and R2 uses an extractor too weak to be informative, so the attribution is bounded from NEITHER side. A detector at recall >0.9 is the single most valuable missing measurement.
ladder_anchor_correction: the directive stated R0 ~ R1 ~ 0.9524. R0 is spglib on ground-truth positions = 210/210 = 1.0000 EXACTLY at the canonical labelling tolerance (symprec 0.01, angle_tolerance 5.0), because the label IS that computation. R0 is definitional; the R0->R1 interval (1.0000 -> 0.9524) is what camera inversion plus correspondence re-solution loses, which the directive's version discards.
